fieldNotes.truckGate: Confirmed: Street View (2025-11) shows a metal swing-gate / barrier with a central island and bollards across the access road; the truck yards are fully fenced (perimeter fence visible in multiple satellite views).
fieldNotes.guardShack: No standalone guard booth positively resolved. The roadway barrier in the woods has no booth; the NW truck-yard entrance has a maintenance canopy and a round storage tank, not a clear guard booth. Flagged uncertain.
fieldNotes.remoteGs: Set true because truckGate is confirmed and no guard booth was confirmable — implies kiosk / call-box check-in. The site is a 1995-vintage import DC newly acquired by HD (Jan 2025); security posture may be evolving. Flagged uncertain.
fieldNotes.shipRcvSeparate: Cross-dock SDC: dock doors run along both long faces (NE and SW) of the building.
fieldNotes.drivewayLong: Long wooded access drive from Crossroads Pkwy plus a deep internal truck yard give 3+ truck stacking room.
fieldNotes.backupSensitive: Gate set far back from public roads on a long wooded drive — no risk of queue spilling onto a through road.
fieldNotes.fastLaneOpportunity: Wide paved truck yards and entrance apron leave room for an express/bypass lane.
fieldNotes.urbanRural: Edge-of-metro site ringed by woodland and water-retention ponds outside Savannah's dense fabric; judged Rural.
fieldNotes.dropArea: Hundreds of trailers / import containers parked along both long faces; 50+ band.
fieldNotes.dropYard: Dedicated trailer / container storage rows on both dock-yard faces, fed by Port of Savannah import flow.
fieldNotes.dockDoorCount: ~200 doors estimated across both long faces of the 1.4M sq ft building; approximate.
fieldNotes.entryLanes: Single access drive serving as both entry and exit; lane counts estimated.
